notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Demo Router R100 versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 are affected by a fictional uncontrolled resource consumption issue. Version 1.2.0 contains the simulated fix; the separate 2.0.0 branch is not affected.

notes.title: Technical overview
notes.text: Unauthenticated requests to the fictional diagnostic service can exhaust its worker pool. The diagnostic service may become unavailable until the service is restarted. The issue is intentionally described without executable attack instructions or payloads.

notes.title: General recommendations
notes.text: For this demonstration, inventory the deployed version, restrict management access, back up configuration, and schedule the update to 1.2.0. Validate normal operation after updating. Disable the diagnostic service on untrusted interfaces.

notes.title: Are these real vulnerabilities?
notes.text: No. All products, issue identifiers, release versions, impact statements, and scores are synthetic. No real CVE identifiers are assigned. The example.com references illustrate the document structure and are not working support or download endpoints.

notes.title: Test data disclaimer
notes.text: This document is provided solely for testing CSAF processing and human-readable display. Do not treat it as evidence that any real product is vulnerable or use it as operational security guidance.

notes.title: Issue summary
notes.text: Unauthenticated requests to the fictional diagnostic service can exhaust its worker pool.

notes.title: Scope and prerequisites
notes.text: The affected service must be reachable over the network; no account is required in this synthetic scenario. Only versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 are covered by the affected status. The 2.0.0 branch uses a different implementation and is not affected.

threats.details: The diagnostic service may become unavailable until the service is restarted.
Synthetic example only. No real exploit, incident, or exploitation in the wild is asserted.

remediations.details: In this fictional scenario, update Demo Router R100 from 1.0.0 or 1.1.0 to 1.2.0 during a maintenance window. Back up configuration, verify the installed version after the update, and confirm normal operation. The linked URL is a placeholder, not a download service.

restart_required.details: A simulated device or application restart is required after the update.

remediations.details: Disable the diagnostic service on untrusted interfaces. This reduces exposure but does not replace the fictional software fix.
Restrict service access to trusted networks, monitor unexpected service activity, and review administrative access until the simulated update is complete.
